sql: WITH bond_pairs AS (SELECT c.bond_id, MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e_low, MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e_high FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL), top_combo AS (SELECT e_low, e_high, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bond_pairs GROUP BY e_low, e_high ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CAST(tc.cnt AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage FROM top_combo tc;
